topic.source_contract: Protected Landscape boundaries, statutory duty, management plans, setting, major development and delivery

scope_guards: A designation boundary is not treated as automatic refusal or permission.
A management plan is not treated as the statutory development plan.
A target framework is not treated as a parcel-specific requirement or delivered outcome.
Land outside the boundary is not treated as irrelevant where setting effects arise.
A policy-compliant design claim is not treated as a completed major-development assessment.
Consultation is not treated as a planning decision.
Proposed landscape mitigation is not treated as secured or established mitigation.
No score or promotion is written without exact boundary/setting, assessment, decision, secured mitigation and delivery evidence.
